hypothesis: The native OHLC stop-first and threshold interpolated fills are not generally identical to first discrete crossing on the existing eight substeps; an IOC reservation is an admission cap, not a continuous mark-to-market cap.
null_hypothesis: For every engineering fixture, native modeled exit ordering and cash result match first-cross discrete path and reservation alone guarantees continuous gross exposure<=12%.
refutation_conditions: One paired fixture with exactly identical OHLCV, fees and tick but different first-cross fills rejects exact exit equivalence.
One reservation-compliant state with market appreciation exceeding contemporaneous 12% refutes the continuous-cap interpretation.
Failure of independent full-law OHLCV or nomination digests blocks any dataset comparison.
An unobserved receipt must not free commitment before knownAt; any contrary native observation is a concrete accounting defect.

overshot stop vs target with identical friction tick and commissions
same OHLC different eight-price order with publication-time separation
